name: How do I prepare my home for fascia board replacement?
description: Prepare for fascia replacement by clearing the perimeter of your home, moving obstructions, and trimming nearby foliage for access.

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for fascia board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for fascia board replacement, ensure clear access around the perimeter of your home by moving any outdoor furniture, potted plants, or other obstructions away from the foundation. Trim back any bushes or tree branches that are too close to the roofline to allow our crew unobstructed access. While our team will handle the bulk of the preparation, clearing the work area beforehand helps ensure a smoother and more efficient process for your project in areas like Oakland or San Leandro.
